sessions.title: The amount that kept changing
sessions.focus: Owen gives several versions of his weekly alcohol use and notices the urge to secure reassurance.
sessions.possible_movement: He agrees to a formal substance-use and medical assessment.
sessions.carry_forward: Gather accurate history without punitive framing.

sessions.title: The drive home
sessions.focus: They address the driving episode directly and assess current access and likelihood of recurrence.
sessions.possible_movement: Owen gives his partner the spare keys and defines alternatives.

sessions.title: Sleep is not the whole story
sessions.focus: Owen describes drinking to sleep and waking unrefreshed.
sessions.possible_movement: The therapist avoids medical advice beyond scope and coordinates evaluation.

sessions.title: Five o'clock without a job
sessions.focus: A daily cue emerges when the workday used to end.
sessions.possible_movement: Owen builds external structure and contacts his sibling before the usual first drink.

sessions.title: The promise his partner no longer trusts
sessions.focus: His partner responds cautiously to another declaration of change.
sessions.possible_movement: Owen practices acknowledging impact without demanding immediate trust.

sessions.title: Craving and the long evening
sessions.focus: A difficult interview increases urge and self-criticism.
sessions.possible_movement: He uses an agreed support and leaves the cue-rich environment.

sessions.title: Who he is without the pitch
sessions.focus: Job loss grief surfaces beneath rehearsed optimism.
sessions.possible_movement: Owen describes shame without making alcohol the only available relief.

sessions.title: The lapse he almost omitted
sessions.focus: Owen reports drinking after two lower-use weeks and initially minimizes the amount.
sessions.possible_movement: He corrects the record within session and reassesses driving and withdrawal risk.
sessions.carry_forward: Update the care plan with specialists.

sessions.title: Repair without surveillance
sessions.focus: Owen and his partner struggle over monitoring and privacy.
sessions.possible_movement: He distinguishes consensual accountability from making his partner solely responsible.

sessions.title: A plan that includes bad weeks
sessions.focus: They review risk, structure, specialized care, relationship repair, and employment uncertainty.
sessions.possible_movement: Owen defines progress as earlier honesty and safer action, not a flawless story.
sessions.carry_forward: Continue the appropriate level of care.
